summary.text: Ben Waxman is a Democratic member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives for District 182, which he has represented since December 2022, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Waxman's career experience includes working as a publisher, a journalist and an organizer.

paragraphs.text: Waxman lives in Center City, Pennsylvania, and graduated from Springfield Township High School in 2003.
He earned a degree in political science from Juniata College in 2007.
He served on the boards of the Center City Residents Association and the Jewish Labor Committee.
Waxman assumed office in the House on December 1, 2022, succeeding Brian Sims.
In the 2023-2024 session he was assigned to the Appropriations, Finance and Gaming Oversight committees.
